programme.title: 飛越杜鵑窩
programme.desc: A rebellious convict is sent to a psychiatric hospital for evaluation in 1963 Oregon, and encourages his docile companions to take more control of their lives and defy the tyrannical head nurse.(n)

programme.title: 七俠歸來
programme.desc: Yul Brynner returns as the good guy dressed in black who calls on five gunfighters (including Robert Fuller, Warren Oates and Claude Akins) to defend a town under siege by vicious outlaws.(n)

programme.title: 我的湊B日記
programme.desc: ‘Ah-young', a grown orphan with government aid cut off, starts working as a nanny for ‘Young-chae', a single mother who works at a bar to make ends meet. One day, while Ah-young is asleep, Young-chae comes home drunk and seriously injures her baby by mistake. As Young-chae blames it on Ah-young, they drift apart. Then one day, Ah-young finds out that Young-chae is trying to give her baby up for adoption, and goes to stop her.

programme.title: 哪一天我們會飛
programme.desc: Unfulfilled at work and dissatisfied with her marital life, a middle-aged woman attends a high school reunion and finds a floodgate of flashbacks of her salad days open before her mind's eyes. She was inseparable with two boys 20 years ago but married one of them eventually. All the memories eventually zero in on one critical incident that changed her life and those of the boys forever..

programme.title: 老師！你會不會談戀愛
programme.desc: Ohno is an introverted math tutor at a cram school who can barely hold a conversation. He wants to fall in love and get married, like an “ordinary” person, but it just doesn't work out whenever he tries. Then his savior appears: a teenage girl named Kasumi, who knows all about “normal love”. The two of them team up to try and help Ohno in his romance.

programme.title: 美人魚
programme.desc: Hin's real estate project involved reclamation of the sea, threatening the livelihood of the residents who relied on the sea to make a living. Bearing family secrets, Shan was dispatched to stop Hin. During their encounters, they fall in love with each other. Even though Hin stopped the reclamation plan out of his love for Shan, Shan got injured in an accident and vanished into the sea.

programme.title: 爆谷電影背後
programme.desc: Bring you the behind-the-scene of this much anticipated Chinese blockbuster directed, co-written, and co-produced by Stephen Chow. Tune-in here for《Mermaid》.

programme.title: 我的天堂城市
programme.desc: Three stories, three struggles for survival, strung together in search of happiness. My Heavenly City uses three interconnected stories to explore the hopeful aspirations of new Asian immigrants moving to New York City – the city of their dreams. We follow a lonely young woman moving to the city to work as a Chinese-English translator, a young couple obsessed with hip-hop and parents dealing with a child with mental illness. They unknowingly influence each other as their paths cross, affecting each other in ways as they go about their lives.

programme.title: 低一點的天空
programme.desc: Fat Cat, a nickname because of his chubby body, is a moderately mentally handicapped person. He works happily and passionately as a delivery boy in a restaurant. Little Cheung is a spastic with normal IQ working as an office boy. Fairy Snow White, name it after a renowned Chinese opera actress, is a blissful, middle-class daughter. Her bright future suddenly turned vague when she became blind at age twelve. From then on, she is living in the dark, but her childhood memories enable her to live in peace and harmony. Fat Cat, Little Cheung and Snow White become good friends afterwards, sharing their respective dream. They don't think it is feasible except Fat Cat does..

programme.title: 三人行
programme.desc: Zhau is a young doctor who desperately needs a successful operation on a high-profile patient to redeem a previous failure which not only cost the life of a patient but her self-esteem. Han is a suspect of multiple armed robberies and homicides, who has been taken to the hospital after being shot with a bullet in his head during a showdown with the police. Officer Lok is at first sight a gung-ho policeman who has participated in the showdown, but when he makes desperate attempts to do Han in by exploiting Zhau's weaknesses, it is apparent he is harboring a much darker secret..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -聽不見的擂台
programme.desc: Sho Miyake, the Japanese director of Small, Slow but Steady, has showed up in Hong Kong to promote and present this ‘hushed' boxing film to the audience face-to-face. What is the meaning within his film? And how he made use of sound arrangements in order to allow audience experience a world like the main character of hearing-impaired does? In this episode, he will also reveal his reason of using 16mm film so that had repetitive takes avoided by actor in this work.

programme.title: 決戰中女社: 惠子的凝視
programme.desc: Despite battling lifelong deafness, Keiko has managed to turn pro and obtain a winning record. But as her mentor faces health issues and her gym faces imminent closure due to the pandemic, Keiko finds her will to keep fighting starting to wane.

programme.title: 片場職人 -劉永
programme.desc: Anthony Lau, the popular actor in the 1970s, was actually Bruce Lee's protege and known for their work in acclaimed action films. Despite the popularity and recognition for his roles as emperor in TV drama series, he failed to continue success due to personal life but after half a century at this career he has never forgotten his master's teachings. In this episode, Anthony recounts the precious moments with Bruce and unveils his own acting journey.

programme.title: 小白龍情海翻波
programme.desc: 'Little White Dragon', a noblewoman and a kung fu hero whose beauty soon caught the eyes of the crown prince. He sent White Dragon to capture an assassin, a blind swordsman..

programme.title: 該死的阿修羅
programme.desc: During the night of his 18th birthday, Jan-Wen committed a random shooting homicide in the crowed night-market, with his self-made modified gun and for some mysterious reasons. The tragic incident caused the life of his family and friends, the victims, and the witnesses all facing the tremendous impact in the aftermath. However, what if there was a chance for these people to make different choices, will the tragedy remain? Will it be a brand new outcome if they all altered their behavior at the crucial moment.

programme.title: 衝鋒車
programme.desc: Lucifer and his gangsters dress their minibus to resemble a police vehicle, and pose as policemen for a robbery. At the robbery the gangsters engage in a gunfight against the real criminals, who kill randomly. Lucifer and his men are infuriated. They may wear police costumes and use toy guns, but their passion is real. Sensing their righteous passion, Chui decides to side with the imposters and their 16-passenger EU vehicle. Lucifer and his men re-discover the bond they felt when they used to battle together.

programme.title: 導火線
programme.desc: Yen's Inspector Ma involved in a difficult case versus a trio of deadly Vietnamese bad guys. Inspector Ma's partner Wilson poses as a member of the gang to keep tabs on the trio, leading to the arrest of Archer. However, Archer's cohorts Tony and Tiger are still at large, and will stop at nothing to prevent Wilson and other witnesses from testifying..

programme.title: 漫長的一天
programme.desc: A story about people meeting and parting with each other as they wander through a dreamlike day. They are all wandering, in her memories, in his novel and in their movies. An omnibus film that explores hellos, goodbyes, longings and reunions throughout the events of a single day.

programme.title: 繼續爭氣
programme.desc: In 2013, My Voice, My Life followed classes of students from three high schools for underprivileged kids and one school for the visually impaired as they embarked on a voyage of self-discovery through taking part in a musical production. Six years later, what kinds of lives are they leading now? My Voice, My Life Revisited goes in search of four of those students: Ah Bok, Coby, Sio Fan and Tsz Nok, charting their transformation and how they have grown over these past few years, as well as the challenges they are facing today.

programme.title: 信用欺詐師JP：英雄篇
programme.desc: The “Third Generation Tsuchinoko” -- the master con man hailed as a “hero” has died. Dako, Boku-chan and Richard all honed their skills under his tutelage. The title of 'Tsuchinoko' is handed down in secrecy to the Confidence Man (scammer) with the greatest skill, setting the stage for a showdown between his three star pupils. The contest will take place in the world heritage city of Valletta, Malta, an international gathering place for the rich and famous.Their target is the invaluable ancient Greek sculpture “Dancing Venus”, currently owned by a wealthy, retired Spanish gangster. Each scammer adopts a unique strategy in pursuit of the target, but the police and Interpol are also hot on their heels. Who will laugh last?! No one knows how the biggest scam in history will end! Who is the true 'hero' and what is the ultimate 'truth'? The last con game, grand finale, Battle Royale...begins now.

programme.title: 奪冠
programme.desc: With glorious days from five consecutive championships in the 1980s, the Women's National Volleyball Team of China had transcended the conventional definition of sports in the hearts of Chinese people. When the Chinese team was pitted against the US team led by Lang Ping at the 2008 Beijing Volleyball Game, everyone knew that it was a match that China could not lose, and certainly could not afford to lose. Defeated, the Chinese team plunged into the deepest abyss in three decades. As Lang Ping returned to her country to coach the team, many mused aloud as to whether China's Women's National Volleyball Team would be able to retrieve lost grounds. The film recounts the ups and downs, the sweat and sacrifice of the team over the past four decades. While the team's persistence and teamwork became a national inspiration and collective memory in the 80s, whether the team spirit can be passed down to the new generation as China goes through rapid changes.

programme.title: 我的麻煩老友
programme.desc: A-Gan is a mean and stingy but successful salesman. One day he has a car accident and meets his own conscious. His Conscious just gives him 7 days to live. A-Gan convinces it to let him live on if 7 people come and visit him. Disappointed by his colleagues' attitudes, A-Gan meets A-Tong, a girl who is as rude and mean as him. They finally change their bad personalities and A-Gan saves his own life by having 7 visitors.

programme.title: 搶紅
programme.desc: Shui Zhang and Waley were buddies at an orphanage. Adopted by a French couple and moved to France at a young age, Waley has become a wine connoisseur prodigy. Left alone in China, Shui Zhang grows up to be a braggart and a nobody. When Shui Zhang travels to France one day to enlist Waley's help in auctioning a bottle of red wine called 'The God of Wine,' said to contain Kublai Khan's secret wine-brewing recipe, Waley accepted the challenge in a heartbeat. During the auction, Waley encounters a representative from the seller, the beautiful Yvonne, and falls in love with her at first sight. The other potential buyer is the wealthy and imposing coal tycoon Changfang Fang. While he appears to be a rich and vulgar brute on the surface, he is much more than meets the eyes. Adding to the mystery is the private connoisseur of suspicious origins following Fang everywhere. To Waley's surprise, Zhang and Fang seem to be sharing secrets between themselves. The group of buyers set off an.

programme.title: 拳霸無銀用
programme.desc: Thongpoon wants to produce a movie by using his gift of martial art to be a leading actor. Without money, he joins a boxing gambling for finding funds, but at last he becomes a prizefighter unexpectedly.

programme.title: 老鼠愛上貓
programme.desc: Based on the popular Chinese novel Qi Xia Wu Yi about the story of Judge Pao in the Song Dynasty and his group of heroic helpers, who together solve cases and catch criminals galore. In the original story, Zhan Zhao is constantly at loggerheads with Bai Yutong, a Robin Hood figure who assists Judge Pao from the other side of the law. Their conflict experiences a modern rendition in this hilariously iconoclastic film.

programme.title: 片場職人 -伍允龍
programme.desc: From stuntman to action choreographer, Phillip Ng's presence has spanned the spectrum of cinematic martial arts. What is it about martial arts that captivates him, driving his dedication to Hong Kong film industry? In this episode, Phillip is going to talk about his self-preparation as a stuntman and dissect the aesthetics of action films.

programme.title: 決戰中女社: 女士復仇
programme.desc: If hell hath no fury like a woman scorned, imagine the nightmare that's about to be visited upon the man who has scorned three women. Professional killer Chanel has been happily married for ten years, but she discovers that her husband has been carrying on an affair with Dior, a thief. Before the women can tear each other apart, they learn that he also has a third woman, Hermes. When the avenging duo arrives at a hotel to stop their next rendezvous, they find out that Hermes is ready for war.

programme.title: 片場職人 -麥兆輝
programme.desc: Graduated from acting major, Alan Mak has been cultivating in the film industry for over three decades and often serving as director or screenwriter. He created numerous remarkable films such as “Infernal Affairs” and “Overheard 3” that not only earned him notable recognition in the form of awards but also demonstrated his curiosity toward human nature. In this episode, he is going to revisit and dissect the film universe through his works.....

programme.title: 怪物
programme.desc: When her young son Minato starts to behave strangely, his mother feels that there is something wrong. Discovering that a teacher is responsible, she storms into the school demanding to know what's going on. But as the story unfolds through the eyes of mother, teacher and child, the truth gradually emerges.

programme.title: 30日求「分」大作戰
programme.desc: “I was perfect until God threw this woman into my life” JUNG-YEOL, the intelligent and handsome loser. “He's like a mosquito. Who knows why they exist?” NARA, the successful careerwoman born with a side of crazy. Despite being brought together by a cinematic encounter that led to their storybook romance, the two have now grown sick of each other's nutty and loserish ways, finally deciding to become perfect strangers again. But......with D-30 until they stamp their papers, a fateful accident inflicts amnesia on the star-crossed couple.

programme.title: 點五步
programme.desc: In the year of 1984, the Sino-British Joint Declaration was signed, and the future of Hong Kong became unclear. In the stream of history, this story of a baseball team beneath the Lion Rock had gradually been forgotten. In that year, 'Shatin Martins', the first Hong Kong youth baseball team, was formed. The 10 young players were living an uneasy and restless life as Hong Kong was being humiliated by one defeat after another and the fate of the 'Shatin Martins'..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 總是有愛在隔離
programme.desc: On a quiet and peaceful afternoon, the Hong Kong Grande Hotel suddenly becomes the center of attention when it is suspected to be the epicenter of the coronavirus outbreak. The Center for Disease Control orders the hotel to be sealed, forcing its guests to undergo a mandatory 14-day quarantine. However, being isolated from the world ends up bringing the quarantined people together in unexpected ways. As they bond over this difficult time, they learn to treasure what may be their final moments together.

programme.title: 蠟筆小新劇場版：超時空！我的新娘
programme.desc: Shinchan Nohara sends a girl named Tamiko on a mission to bring his five-year-old self to that time period right before being captured. Reaching the past, she claims to be Shinchan's bride and takes him and his friends on a wild adventure to try to save the world to come.

programme.title: 海的盡頭是草原
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, Du Siheng was sent to Shanghai Orphanage by her mother, who couldn't support two kids. Later, she was transferred to Inner Mongolia and adopted by a loving family. Sixty years later, Du Sihan set out for Inner Mongolia and embarked on a journey to find his elder sister. The journey, however, turned out to be full of twists and turns...... Du Siheng couldn't adapt to the life on the grassland when she first arrived in Inner Mongolia. Touched by the love and warmth from the Mongolia people, the young Du Siheng gradually integrated into her new family. After six decades, the sister and brother reunited again and finally let go of the past. They reminisced the days when their fathers fought for the land beneath their feet and drew motivation from the older generation to work hard for a more promising and prosperous future.

programme.title: 十月圍城
programme.desc: 1906, City of Victoria (British Colony of Hong Kong). In the distance of thirteen blocks, the one man who holds a nation's fate must survive relentless attempts on his life with only eight bodyguards to protect him. Against hundreds of assassins, these men must put their courage to the test in order to protect the hopes of millions in this perilous night even if it means fighting to the death..

programme.title: 祖宗膠戰外星人
programme.desc: In the year 2022, Guard and Thunder live on Earth, managing alien prisoners who have been locked up in humans' brains. One day, a spacecraft appears in the sky over Seoul, and the police detective Moon witnesses a strange sight...Meanwhile 630 years earlier during the Goryeo Dynasty, the hapless dosa (Korean tao magician) Muruk and Ean, the so-called “The Girl Who Shoots Thunder”, each scramble to outwit each other in pursuit of the mystical Divine Blade, for which a huge reward is being offered. Two sorcerers in search of the Divine Blade's secrets, Madam Black and Mr. Blue, as well as the masked Jajang, also set out on a desperate scramble to obtain the Blade. Meanwhile, a spacecraft emerges from a deep river, emitting light...Those who pursue alien prisoners locked in human bodies in the year 2022, and the sorcerers who pursue the legendary Divine Blade in the year 1391... When the door of time opens, everything becomes entangled.

programme.title: 走佬驚驚團
programme.desc: Gang of friends who never thought to do any good things, get luck by winning lotto. They bring all money to casino with hope it will be increased but get a huge debt instead. They decide to rob a car without knowing that there is a dead body inside. Their mission turns into 2, escape from police as suspected murderers and they have to get away from owner of the casino.

programme.title: 溫暖的抱抱
programme.desc: WARM HUG is a romance-comedy revolving around a boy with OCD and is not interested in both friendship and love. However, after meeting a unique doctor and a carefree girl, the three of them slowly learn and understand one another along the way..

programme.title: 蠟筆小新劇場版：大對決！機械人爸爸的反擊
programme.desc: A high tech company which specialises in making robots for construction turns Hiroshi nohara in a robot who then along with shinosuke fights to reclaim his original body fighting other robots.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 決戰中女社: 追捕
programme.desc: Manhunt follows the journey of upstanding lawyer Du Qiu, who is unwittingly drawn into a murder case when all the evidence at the scene points to him being the perpetrator. Knowing that he's been framed by Luo Zhi, Du Qiu runs from the law to uncover the truth. The police launch a large-scale manhunt, but veteran detective Yamura sees that this seemingly open-and-shut case is not that simple after all. During the intense pursuit, a bond begins to build between the fugitive and his pursuer, even though Yamura knows that he can't fully trust Du Qiu. Is the real killer lurking elsewhere? Is there a hidden conspiracy behind the murder.

programme.title: 鐵三角
programme.desc: Life has not been kind to Sam, Fai and Mok as they struggle to make ends meet. Routine visits to bars seem to be their only way out of miseries. Until a stormy evening when a mysterious old man appears before them with a tip: An ancient treasure is buried under the high-security Legislative Building. All they have to do is sneak in and retrieve it; if they believe in his story. Sam, Fai and Mok agree to make a run for the treasure to test their fate. What they uncover is beyond anything they expected: An ancient coffin containing a ceremonial robe made of gold..

credits.director: 徐克, 林嶺東, 杜琪峯

programme.title: 特務打爆機
programme.desc: No one can stop us from going to Hawaii. Mi-yeong, an ordinary lady who sells donuts, goes on her first family trip. However, their excitement doesn't last so long. Strange people are on board with them and tries to hijack the plane. In the moment of emergency, an unexpected hero appears to save the plane. Will her dreamlike vacation come true.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -時也、命也、案也
programme.desc: MAD FATE, produced by the dynamic trio, Johnnie To, Soi Cheang and Yau Nai-hoi, depicts a story of mankind fighting against fate. The director reveals that he was once hesitant to choose Lokman, the leader of boy group MIRROR, to be the leading actor and only confirmed him right before the filming began. What made Lokman chosen and how did he prepare for his character? Is the director trying to reflect on ‘fate', from a new angle? Let Soi Cheang and Lokman share in this episode of BAOGU PRODUCES.

programme.title: 命案
programme.desc: On a rainy evening, a fortune telling master tries to help a prostitute avert certain death, but fate has plans of its own. He arrives at the prostitute's home just a few minutes too late, watching her take her last breath while Siu Tung stares at her corpse with creepy fascination. When he foretells that Siu Tung will soon commit murder, the Master believes that he has the power to change the inevitable. On the contrary, the veteran detective who once sent Siu Tung to jail for brutally killing a cat believes that Siu Tong is a born psychopath whose bloodthirst cannot be stopped. While Siu Tung becomes increasingly overwhelmed by his insatiable desire for murder, the Master puts his sanity on the line to change the course of fate. But is it possible to defeat the all-powerful force that paves life's path.

programme.title: 韓戲逼人
programme.desc: After his successful debut, Director KIM endures scathing attacks from critics who call him a specialist in trashy dramas. After finishing his latest feature ‘Cobweb', he has vivid dreams over several days of an alternative ending to the film. Sensing that if he can just shoot those scenes as he envisioned them, a masterpiece will surely emerge, he tries to arrange just two days of additional shooting. However, the rewritten script fails to pass censorship, and his actors can't make sense of the new ending. Between the tangled schedule, the opposition of the producer, and the collision between these fantastic scenes dancing before his eyes and the harsh conditions of reality, Director KIM feels he is about to go insane, but he pushes on regardless..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -韓戲入骨
programme.desc: Song Kang Ho, winner of the Best Actor Award at the Cannes Film Festival, as well as the leading actor of Cobweb, visited Hong Kong and was interviewed by Director Jack Ng. Cobweb tells a story about a movie set in Korea during the 1970s. In the movie, Song Kang Ho acted as Director Kim, who wouldn't care to stand against others in order to achieve perfection. In this episode, Song Kang Ho will share how he pondered his character in the movie, and what's his impression on Hong Kong movies.

programme.title: 為你鍾情
programme.desc: Winnie never knows her mother. Ever since she was a toddler, her father and scientist grandfather had weaved the tale that she works for Santa Claus. Not until Winnie turns twenty does the incredible truth finally dawns on her, when she accidentally opens a freezing chamber in his grandfather's laboratory and resurrects a mysterious young woman inside. This woman is none other than Winnie's long lost mother, Gigi, who, unbeknownst to her daughter, has been cyronically frozen since a fatal car accident twenty years ago. Still very much a teenager, Gigi is shaken not only by the presence of a daughter physically older than her but also by the devastating news that her idol Leslie Cheung has passed away during her long slumber. To make up for lost time, she sets off with Winnie in search of her boyfriend, Kit, who happens to be Winnie's biological father. The Kit that Gigi used to know was a dashingly handsome young man fully convinced he would become a pop star some day. When G.

programme.title: 與神同行
programme.desc: According to the laws of Afterlife, all deceased must go through 7 trials over 49 days divided into 7 sin categories: betrayal, violence, filial piety, murder, indolence, deceit, and injustice. Once the deceased clears all 7 trials, he can be reincarnated and start a new life. “Mr. Kim Ja-hong, you died as expected without complications.” Having died unexpectedly at a scene of fire while trying to save a little girl, firefighter Ja-hong is taken to the purgatory by 3 Afterlife guardians – Kang-lim, Hewonmak and Deok-choon. As the first paragon in 19 years, he must go through 7 trials over 49 days in order to be reincarnated. The 3 guardians were promised of reincarnation as well by King Yeomra, who rules the Afterlife, if they successfully defend 49 souls and do their best defend Ja-hong's innocence in trials as their 48th client. His journey progresses without a hitch, until his brother Su-hong, who died begrudgingly, has turned into a Vengeful Spirit and begins attacking th.

programme.title: 慌心假期
programme.desc: Michele takes off for Europe to contemplate her inevitable divorce. She meets the beautiful Miki, a Japanese model who tries to end a relationship with a married man. There is nothing like love trouble to foster a quick bond and the women become close friends. However, during an evening of drunken revelry, Miki discloses by accident that she is the other woman of Michele's husband..

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：古天樂: 意外
programme.desc: A self-styled “accident choreographer,” the Brain is a professional hitman who kills his victims by trapping them in well crafted “accidents” that look like unfortunate mishaps but are in fact perfectly staged acts of crime. Perennially plagued with guilt, he is also suspicious and morbid by nature. The recent avalanche of memories of his lost wife does not make things any easier. After one mission accidentally goes wrong, causing the life of one of his men, the Brain is convinced that this accident has been choreographed: someone is out there plotting to terminate him and his team. He becomes increasingly paranoid, walking on the thin line between reality and delusion..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 單身男女
programme.desc: Yen is a single girl from China working in an IT company in Hong Kong. Overwhelmed by the hustle and bustle of this sleepless city, she feels increasingly like a fish out of water. Until she meets a handsome hunk, Sean and an elite architect, Kevin. Yen is no longer alone and lonely, but will she be able to find her true love.

programme.title: 來自雪國的遺書
programme.desc: In 1945, after the end of World War II, Hatao Yamamoto was imprisoned in a concentration camp in Sibera, Russia. Despite the harsh, despairing condition in the camp, Hatao Yamamoto kept telling other prisoners not to give up hope, and that the day when they could all go back home would come. Hatao Yamamoto firmly believed that he would return to Japan and meet his wife, Mojimi Yamamoto, and their children someday. 8 years after the war, he received a postcard from his wife with a one-line message written on it, stating that “We are waiting for you to come back”. Meanwhile, Hatao Yamamoto's health was deteriorating rapidly. After having a diagnosis, the doctor told him that he had only three months left... After listening to his friends' advices, he decided to write a will and left it to his friends to bring it to his family when they were released. However, the will was seen as a spying message by the officers in the concentration camp and was confiscated..

programme.title: 異度空間
programme.desc: Yan always sees dead people. Jim, her psychologist, thinks it's all in her mind bought by loneliness and by unpleasant experiences past relationships. He devotes all his time to curing her. Jim soon falls in love as Yan is freed of her vision. But then he starts seeing dead people too. Jim remembers his past. His girlfriend in high school, named Yu, committed suicide when Jim tried to break up with her in twenty years ago. Now, with Yan's help and love, can Jim face up to the ghost and end the nightmare.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 爆谷獨家首播：決戰中女社: 臨時決鬥
programme.desc: “CHUNG LUI SOCIETY” is a boxing gym founded by the former legendary Muay Thai champion CHUNG Lui, who is dedicated to training professional fighters. Despite the gym's struggles, he remains committed to his lifelong philosophy of never backing down from a challenge. Businesswoman Elsa discovers that her boyfriend Daniel is cheating on her with Macau's female champion, Surewin. Driven by her competitive spirit, Elsa vows to settle their score in the ring. Upon learning that Surewin was Lui's former student, Elsa seeks him out to train her at his gym. Upon learning that Surewin was Lui's former student, Elsa seeks him out to train her at his gym. There, she encounters MOK Ka Lei, who had previously clashed with her during an advertisement shoot. After leaving the entertainment industry to support her family, Ka Lei attempts to make a comeback, with the help of her friend LAM Pik Chu. Under the rigorous training of Lui's protege, KO Chau, Elsa undergoes intense preparation. Alth.

programme.title: 東京復仇者
programme.desc: Takemichi Hanagaki leads a dead-end life in a run-down apartment while working part-time at a job for a younger manager who treats him like an idiot. Then one day, he learns that a girl he used to date during his hooligan days in middle school, Hinata Tachibana, and her brother, Naoto, have been murdered by the Kanto area's most villainous hoodlums, Tokyo Manji. The very next day, Takemichi is standing on a train platform when he is suddenly pushed onto the tracks. But instead of dying, Takemichi is transported ten years into the past where he is reunited with Hinata's younger brother, Naoto. “10 years from now, Hinata and you will be killed” he tells Naoto, thus altering the future. Hinata still doesn't survive, but Naoto does, becoming a police detective. Returning to the present day, Takemichi recruits Naoto's help in returning to the past to crush Tokyo Manji and save his Hinata's life once and for all. All Takemichi needs to do to travel through time is to shake hands w.

programme.title: 救參的士
programme.desc: In 1987, diplomat 'Min-jun' was unable to escape the Middle East Department at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for five years. One day, he receives a coded message from a missing diplomat in Lebanon, who was kidnapped 20 months ago. Filled with hopeful aspirations of a promotion to the United States if successful, he volunteers for an unofficial mission to rescue his colleague and heads to Lebanon. Upon arrival at the airport, 'Min-jun' narrowly avoids a hail of bullets from airport security guards who are after his life. By chance, he ends up getting into the car of a Korean taxi driver named 'Pan-su'. With local gangsters hot on their heels attempting to steal the ransom money, 'Min-jun' has no choice but to rely on expat Pan-su, the only fellow Korean around. However, can this shady character, who will do anything for money, truly help in rescuing his colleague.

programme.title: 心裏美
programme.desc: Mr. K.K. Ho, is a leading “star tutor” with remarkable achievements. Lee Lung Kei , the stingy boss and principal of the cram school, regards Mr. Ho as a trump card. Chloe, a traditional high school teacher, has always tried her best in teaching. Chloe despises K.K.'s teaching methods and refers to them as deviant. The two of them give tit for tat in class. Their conflict leads to K.K.'s appreciation for Chloe. He gives her flowers as an apology, but Chloe never accepts. He finds out Chloe is the daughter of Principal Lee. When she was young, she witnessed her mother being bullied and died by accident. That is why she deeply hates her father and refuses to get in touch with him. K.K. with wisdom and courage, who breaks through all the obstacles to pursue Chloe but also takes into account the father-daughter relationship. However, he learns Chloe has genetic heart disease and what's worse, due to her diligent teaching for years, the doctor believes that she could only live for.

programme.title: 殺出個黃昏
programme.desc: Last generation of assassins moved to HK in 50/60's and posted as “killer-for-hire' trio to fix all sort of problems for their clients. Decades passed, they now become redundant themselves at work and home. An accidental mission calls upon them turns out to be an assisted suicide. The trio suddenly finds new ‘life'.....as ”Guardian Angels of the Elders”. Just when they are finding meanings to this new role, an order from a teenager turns their new practice upside down again......this might as well be their very last job.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 逆權司機
programme.desc: May 1980. A Seoul taxi driver named Man-seob comes across an offer too good to be true. If he drives a foreign passenger from Seoul down to Gwangju and back again before the curfew, he'll be paid the unthinkable sum of 100,000 won – enough to cover several months of unpaid rent. Without stopping to ask the details, he picks up the German reporter Peter and sets off along the highway. Although stopped by police roadblocks at the edge of Gwangju, Man-seob is desperate to earn his taxi fare, and eventually manages to find a way into the city. There they encounter students and ordinary citizens taking part in large-scale demonstrations against the government. Man-seob, alarmed by the danger in the air, pleads with Peter to go quickly back to Seoul. But Peter ignores him..

programme.title: 蠟筆小新劇場版：黃金間諜大作戰
programme.desc: A girl named Remon suddenly appears. She shows Shinnosuke a message which is sent from Shinnosuke's hero action mask. Shinnosuke totally believes Remon and they start spy training together. They duo become action spies and finally get a mission from the action mask. That mission is '.. the doctor of evil stole my precious capsule. Take it back'.

programme.title: 怒潮
programme.desc: Amid the transfer of power at the Hongtai Group, which wields influence in both the lawful and unlawful worlds, a mysterious assassin named Chen An suddenly enters this vortex of confusion and throws the Hongtai Group into chaos. Mai Longwen from the police and Ma Wenkang from the gangs both have their eyes on him... Various forces are waiting for the opportunity to strike. Who is the mastermind behind the scenes? A fierce battle is about to break out.

programme.title: 片場職人 -劉永
programme.desc: Anthony Lau, the popular actor in the 1970s, was actually Bruce Lee's protege and known for their work in acclaimed action films. Despite the popularity and recognition for his roles as emperor in TV drama series, he failed to continue success due to personal life but after half a century at this career he has never forgotten his master's teachings. In this episode, Anthony recounts the precious moments with Bruce and unveils his own acting journey.

programme.title: 原諒他77次
programme.desc: When Adam and Eva break up after ten years, Adam thinks the breach was caused by one trivial incident, but Eva knows she's already forgiven Adam 77 times! Sweethearts since law school, Adam changed professions to start a Thai boxing studio and gradually became indifferent to Eva. Seemingly petty matters, like forgetting she hates raisin cookies, become the catalyst for her moving out and changing her Facebook status to 'single'. Despondent, Adam has a drunken tryst with his student, Mandy. Adam gains new insight after accidentally discovering Eva's private journal. Entitled '77 Heartbreaks', the title refers to the philosophy that 'forgiving someone 7 times isn't enough; 70 x 7 times is too much; so go ahead and forgive 77 times!' Reading it makes Adam realize his love. But what can he do to win her back? And what secret is contained in the journal's torn-out last page? He rushes to Eva and melts her heart by recounting their happy memories. When Eva tells him Heartbreak #77.

programme.title: 阿宅的戀愛太難
programme.desc: At her new company, Narumi Momose, a 26-year-old office clerk, is reunited with her childhood friend Hirotaka Nifuji. Hirotaka is a good-looking and competent businessman, but he is actually a severe game otaku. On the other hand, Narumi is a closet “fujoshi” (women who like anime, manga, and novels). Narumi, who more than anything fears being exposed as an otaku, hides her true nature. Hirotaka, a fellow otaku, is the only person she can be herself with. After work, they often go out drinking and have lively discussions on otaku topics. Narumi laments to Hirotaka that she is a poor judge of character and always falls for the wrong guy. Hirotaka responds, “Maybe you'd be comfortable with an otaku boyfriend.” He suggests that they start seeing each other as boyfriend and girlfriend. Narumi agrees. They look forward to being a happy otaku couple, but their romance runs into unexpected walls and challenges.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -「靚」媽駕到
programme.desc: Hong Kong Film Awards' Best Actress winner Anita Yuen with the cast from Malaysia share fun episodes of their collaboration in ‘OMG! Mom's Big News'. Anita shares about her kiss scene with Chan Fong playing as her husband in the film. Their “children” Miko Wong and Juztin Lan also reveal how they were stunned by Anita's aura and skill of breaking the ice when or even before filming. Let's find out what Anita did to win over hearts of the crew.

programme.title: 一念無明
programme.desc: The film begins with an old man who has long been absent as a father, picking up his son, who is suffering from bipolar disorder, from a mental hospital. Both men are in deep remorse for the accident that caused the death of the mother. The tension and anxiety boil as they stay with each other in a tiny subdivided flat. As time passes, they realize the pain between one another is not the only confrontation that awaits them; but to face the cruel world that they are living in.

programme.title: 消失的兇手
programme.desc: A women's prison in the Northern China in 1932, Prisoner FU Yuan (JIANG Yiyan) digs a tunnel in her prison cell with a silver spoon and escapes. Inspector SONG Donglu (LAU Ching-wan) is summoned to investigate FU's escape. By tracking down the letters sent to him by FU, it sets SONG off to Hong City to unravel FU's disappearance.

programme.title: 大搜查之女
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Molline Szeto is assigned to investigate the kidnap of a boy, whose father is the kingpin of illegal red oil in Greater China, John Fok.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -識於微塵
programme.desc: Composer Wong Hin-yan won Hong Kong Film Awards and Golden Horse Awards' ‘Best Original Film Score' with The Narrow Road which was directed by his buddy Lam Sum. In this episode, the two will share about the correlation between soundtracks and visual images, and also look back on their paths from school to films.

programme.title: 窄路微塵
programme.desc: Under this flashy city, amidst the numbness of frustrations, what people are looking forward to is the glimmer of light that might change their lives. Chak, who runs a small cleaning company, barely takes over the cleaning work on his own to make a living. Hitting by the COVID-19 pandemic, small business closed down one by one. One day, a young single mother, Candy, comes to look for a job opportunity from Chak. She doesn't seem like a trustworthy person to Chak, unexpectedly, she helps Chak to resolve many difficulties at work. Life seems like get back on track. The morning sun never lasts a day, Chak's company is being accused, at the same time, his family is facing a nightmare as well, all his hopes are dashed to pieces, but they can still try their best to resist the oppression of life and support each other through this painful year.

programme.title: 千萬別開門
programme.desc: ‘Soo-hyun' buys a used washing machine online after moving into her new place. When she receives a broken machine, she realizes she's been scammed and decides to make sure the seller doesn't get away with it! Eventually, Soo-hyun succeeds in finding the seller's online account, then leaves warnings that he is a fraudster under all his posts to stop him from selling. From then on, terrifying things start to happen to Soo-hyun. She led on ordinary life with an ordinary job, but everything in her daily life begins to fall apart, and an investigation to find the seller unfolds. Later, Soo-hyun goes to the seller's pace with Detective Joo, and discovers a dead body..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -逃出大風鎮
programme.desc: In the film “Trapped”, border town Mangya was taken over by a group of bandits where only three police officers with one pistol stationed. How could they bring all 44 bandits to justice? First-time director Zhang Qi reveals the inspirations and ideas behind in particular the story of notorious four criminals from the Mainland and Hong Kong's “King of Robbery” Yip Kai Foon while also tells more about his creative motive for several scenes of violence on screen.

programme.title: 春嬌救志明
programme.desc: Back together since Love in the Buff, Jimmy and Cherie strive to stay together happily ever after. But the shocking news of Cherie's philandering father marrying a girl younger than herself does not make things any easier for Cherie..

programme.title: 迷城
programme.desc: When former cop-turned-bar owner T-man Kwok (Louis KOO) befriends a drunken woman at closing hours (TONG Liya), they soon find themselves targeted both by her former lover-a high-powered Hong Kong attorney-and the thugs (CHANG Hsiao-Chuan) he employs. Once Kwok's underachieving half-brother (Shawn YUE) and a suitcase full of tainted cash enter the picture, the chase turns deadly, with the brothers' tense family history coming to the surface as Kwok finds himself torn between the triads and his former police colleagues.

programme.title: 長夜盡頭的微光
programme.desc: After a series of mishaps at work caused by her severe pre-menstrual syndrome, Fujisawa lands a new job at an astronomical toy factory, where she meets Yamazoe, a tacit colleague plagued by panic attacks. There the two, whose careers have been derailed by their respective conditions, learn to support and care for each other through life's ups and downs despite their initial friction.

programme.title: 逆向誘拐
programme.desc: Siu-yu, a financial analyst who has been working to complete a budget analyst for an investment bank, finds that a file containing confidential information has been mysteriously deleted. Soon after, her boss, John, receives a ransom email from someone called K Kidnapper, demanding just $190,000 worth of ransom. The ransom must be paid in 3 days, otherwise they will share the information to public. Under a detective's secret investigation, everyone could be the suspect..

programme.title: 片場職人 -麥兆輝
programme.desc: Graduated from acting major, Alan Mak has been cultivating in the film industry for over three decades and often serving as director or screenwriter. He created numerous remarkable films such as “Infernal Affairs” and “Overheard 3” that not only earned him notable recognition in the form of awards but also demonstrated his curiosity toward human nature. In this episode, he is going to revisit and dissect the film universe through his works.....

programme.title: 赤狐書生
programme.desc: To achieve immortality, fox spirit Bai Shisan disguises as a young man and travels to the human world in search of a divine pill. There he befriends the innocent scholar Wang Zijin shom he later realizes is the key to his transcendence. To keep Wang safe, Bai must bond with him on his road to the imperial examination and fends off threats from mythic creatures and evil spirits.

programme.title: 給自己的情歌
programme.desc: Suddenly learning she is terminally ill, 'Se-yeon' asks her husband, 'Jin-bong', the absurd task of helping her find her first love, and he unwillingly joins her search. Along their journey, 'Se-yeon' and 'Jin-bong' are reminded of the most glittering, beautiful moments of their lives.

programme.title: 第三個人
programme.desc: He Wei and Xiao Feng are a perfect couple. One day, her younger sister, Xiao Ke, discovers the man who murdered her parents is He Wei, and she invites him back to her home..

programme.title: 蕩寇風雲
programme.desc: During the 16th century, Japanese pirates proliferate along the Chinese coastline. In 1557, the pirates take over Cengang in Zhejiang. After months of futile advances, Commander Yu finally defeats them under the leadership of newly promoted General Qi. The pirates, however, manage to escape. No sooner has Qi identified the key weakness of the Chinese army than he starts remapping the coastal regions to eradicate the pirates. When he finds the villagers of Yiwu loyal and courageous, he drafts them into his own army which soon becomes a formidable force against the pirates, with tactics developed specifically against them. In 1561, the pirates regroup and once again attack the coastal cities of China. With both the cities of Xinhe and Taizhou under attack, Qi's army is caught between two fires. Even though most family members of his soldiers are located in Xinhe, Qi makes the tough decision to go to Taizhou and leaves his wife in charge of the fight against the pirates in Xinhe.

programme.title: 你咪理，我愛你
programme.desc: I Love You, You're Perfect, Now Change! is a musical comedy with a twist of Hong Kong sentiment, adapted from the hugely popular Broadway Musical of the same title. The original musical premiered Off-Broadway in 1996, and has been running for 23 years. The Hong Kong-based Windmill Grass Theatre adapted the musical and premiered in Hong Kong in 2005. The show had its fifth run in 2017 and had sold out each time. This movie version features 12 vignettes. An ensemble cast of over 60 well-known Hong Kong actors, singers and dancers will be performing multiple hilarious musical numbers that explore one central theme in life – love.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -跨越四徑挑戰
programme.desc: Among Hong Kong's trail running community, there is a legendary mountain race that runners have to complete in total distance of 298km in 72 hours. Without any cash-prize or award for this challenge, passionate runners keep challenging their own perseverance. Director Robin Lee has won the Best New Director award at the Hong Kong Film Awards for his debut documentary “Four Trails”. In this interview, Lee together with runner Jacky Leung will talk about their stories of pain and glory brought by this extreme challenge.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 八佰
programme.desc: The film is based on true stories taking place during Sino-Japanese war in Shanghai, China, in 1937, the battle and protection of the Si Hang Warehouse. There are around 400 soldiers (so called Eight Hundred Heroes in history), holding out against numerous waves of Japanese forces for 4 days and 4 nights..

programme.title: 此情此刻
programme.desc: 'The Moment' talks about four relationships - A couple breaking up yet holding tight; a father and a daughter meeting up after a long separation; a girl escaping from growing up; and two buddies' reunion after years of misunderstanding. Different people carry different stories. The stories are connected by a vintage photography studio holder. Their experiences bring out a variety of sensations to the city we are living in; these feelings belong to them, and also us.(n)

programme.title: 沒有美色殺人狂
programme.desc: 'Do we lacking anything? We have a house, a truck, and very attractive.' Self-proclaimed tough guy Jae-pil and sexy guy Sang-gu leave an unforgettable first impression on their moving day. Despite becoming special surveillance targets for Police Chief Choi and Officer Nam, they are simply happy to start anew in their European-style dream house. However, happiness is short-lived as they are inadvertently mistaken for kidnappers while trying to rescue Mina, who almost drowns. Meanwhile, uninvited guests looking for Mina start appearing, and an ancient spirit sealed in the basement awakens, surrounding the house with dark energy.(n)

programme.title: 攻殼機動隊
programme.desc: In the year 2029, advances in cybernetic technology allowed people to replace body parts and organs for robotic ones. Even the brain could be replaced with a cyber-brain with the ability to gain access to the internet and different networks. Major Motoko Kusanagi, a cyborg agent working for the government, and her team have been given the assignment to track down the notorious hacker known as ‘The Puppetmaster' and uncover his plans. Her mission explores the escalating synergy between humanity and technology, while questioning the very essence of sentient existence.(n)

programme.title: Mrs. K
programme.desc: Mrs. K is a housewife who lives in a quiet suburban neighborhood with her husband Mr. K and their daughter Lil' K. One day, a Macau ex-cop shows up to blackmail Mrs. K. He knows about her unseemly past. She agrees to his term and they meet. The deal goes sour as she attempts to get rid of him. He escapes and is captured by a stranger. After finding out why Ex-cop is mixed up in this, the stranger kills him. They are after Mrs. K for different reasons. Ex-cop is someone who stumbles upon Mrs. K's identity and decides to try his luck. The stranger, however, bears a grudge against Mrs. K. Things would date back more than ten years ago when a Macau casino was robbed. The robbery was carried out by a band of professionals and was led by none other than Mrs. K..(n)

programme.title: 重案行動之搗毒任務
programme.desc: A young girl died of drug addiction, revealing that a new type of drug is spreading rapidly in Hong Kong, affecting young people. The police take the incident seriously and set up an elite team from various departments to eradicate the entire drug cartel. The team investigated from various aspects of tracking, undercover, and forensics, and finally found that the mastermind behind turned out to be a genius drug refiner.(n)

programme.title: 飛翔吧﹗埼玉2
programme.desc: A live-action film adaptation of Mineo Maya's “Fly Me to the Saitama” turned out to be a huge, unexpected box office hit of 2019. With the producers who took the demand for a sequel as real, the cast and crew got back together to complete the second chapter of the urban legend in Fly Me To The Saitama -FROM BIWA LAKE WITH LOVE-. In addition to the biting yet affectionate dissing of Saitama and the Kanto region in the first film, the sequel contains an even more scathing dissing of the Kansai region. Alongside costars GACKT and Fumi Nikaido, Ryo Kato and Tsubasa Masuwaka reprise their roles as members of the Saitama Liberation Front. A crucial protagonist who joins their battle, Kai Kikyo, the handsome leader of the Shiga Liberation Front, is played by Anne in her first role as male character. Akira Kashoji, the ruthless governor of Osaka and kingpin of the Kansai region who stands in the way of Rei and others, is played by Ainosuke Kataoka. In addition to Norika Fujiwara and.(n)

programme.title: 大佬愛美麗
programme.desc: Georgie's dad, Hung, was a Triad leader. After Hung's death, his right-hand Cheung intends to bring back Georgie to take over. But Cheung finds Sam, whom he mistakes for Georgie..(n)

programme.title: 劍雨
programme.desc: In 428AD, Bodhi, Prince of Southern India, becomes a Buddhist monk and sets off for China, earning a hallowed reputation as a mystical martial artist. Following his death, his remains mysteriously disappear. It is rumored that his remains contain the secret to obtaining limitless power and ruling the martial arts world. Centuries later, The Dark Stone emerges as a team of deadly assassins; their best assassin is the ruthless, invincible Drizzle. On her latest mission, Drizzle takes out Zhang Haiduan, a high-ranking court official. Zhang's son, Renfeng, while mourning his father's death, is also attacked and seemingly killed by Drizzle and her fellow assassins. Drizzle's life changes when she kills Lu Zhu, a monk with whom she has unintentionally fallen in love..(n)

programme.title: 大約在冬季
programme.desc: In front of the venue of CHYI Chin's concert, An tries to get herself a concert ticket while the tickets are sold out. Looking at the frustrated girl, Xiao walks towards the girl and gives her free tickets. It was 1991. After two years, An meets Xiao again. They fall in love with each other. The distance between Taipei and Beijing doesn't stop the lovers. However, under the pressure of Xiao's family, the lovers are separated. Xiao is forced to marry another woman..(n)

programme.title: 男航女機師
programme.desc: HAN Jung-woo, a pilot with top-class skills, is flying high and even appears on a famous TV show. But everything comes crashing down when a careless mistake causes him to lose everything, even his job. Blacklisted in the industry, no airline is willing to hire him. Desperate with no other choice, HAN Jung-woo transforms completely into his younger sister's identity and succeeds in landing a job as a pilot. But soon, he encounters more unexpected problems... Will his dream of cruising through life ever take off.(n)

programme.title: 本日公休
programme.desc: For forty years A-Rui has been running a barbershop, a small place where she has seen happiness and sorrow, ebb and flow. Faced with all the troubles in her life, A-Rui fully commits to her work and defeat is never an option for her, but her children never appreciate it and treat her profession with disdain. One day, A-Rui receives a phone call from the family of an old regular client who moved far away a long time ago. The family asks A-Rui if she would be willing to travel to cut the hair for the bedridden old man. Reminded of what her master taught her, “Always provide your best service,” A-Rui decides to hang up the “Day Off” sign and closes her shop for one day. programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners 第2季

Seasoned recovery op Jim’s must rescue an abandoned Toyota from a live lane on the M1. Recovery op Rory visits a depot in Milton Keynes to recover an 8-ton tractor unit normally used to transport pizza. Meanwhile rescue driver Jon must tow a 44-ton bus the wrong way down a dual carriageway….

programme.title: Man Eats Wild 第1季

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this episode crane operator Nick, is called out to a very unusual job removing two old portable cabins from a recycling yard and replacing with new ones. But with each cabin weighing at least four tonnes and overhead electrical cables to negotiate this is a highly hazardous job. Seasoned recovery op Jim’s must rescue an abandoned Toyota from a live lane on the M1. Recovery op Rory visits a depot in Milton Keynes to recover an 8-ton tractor unit normally used to transport pizza. Meanwhile rescue driver Jon must tow a 44-ton bus the wrong way down a dual carriageway….

programme.title: The Whale Whisperer 第1季
programme.desc: This film follows the inspiring relationship between whale whisperer Vicki Neville and the\nhumpback whales of Australia. Never-before-seen behaviours have been documented by a team of five cinematographers over the three-month whale season in Hervey Bay, all captured in glorious 4K. These stunning close encounters capture whales like you have never seen them before.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners 第2季
programme.desc: Jean-Paul breaks off from the crew to hunt a grit pile with a father-son duo, and sees first hand the effort that goes into feeding an entire camp. The crew takes an airboat tour to discover what efforts the state is making to preserve our coast for future generations of hunters and wildlife.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners 第2季
programme.sub-title: Heritage is a Hand Me Down

programme.title: Tasting Tasmania 第1季
programme.desc: Ben Milbourne finishes his exploration of Tasmania heading out to the rocky waters between Hobart and Bruny Island. Guided by Rob from the Seafood Seduction Tour, Ben experiences the freshest seafood imaginable. Ben concludes his journey overlooking the beautiful South Coast.

programme.title: Growing Wild 第1季
programme.desc:
The utility of plants in regulating our environment is paramount but their aesthetics shouldn’t be underestimated. The notion that we first eat with our eyes extends to our relationship with plants.

Weird and wonderful or just plain unassuming, plants seem set out to wit and to woo us, a giant frond waving our way, flowers that open only at 4 p.m. 

Further testament to the uncanny nature of nature, the personalities of plant parents seem to mirror their plant children and vice versa – a plant otaku and his ground-defying airplants, an architect and his sublime flora sculptures.

When bringing more wild into our environment, should we consider our personalities against the plant’s to better coexist? Don’t be afraid to go a little potty.

programme.title: Growing Wild 第1季
programme.desc:
The utility of plants in regulating our environment is paramount but their aesthetics shouldn’t be underestimated. The notion that we first eat with our eyes extends to our relationship with plants.

Weird and wonderful or just plain unassuming, plants seem set out to wit and to woo us, a giant frond waving our way, flowers that open only at 4 p.m. 

Further testament to the uncanny nature of nature, the personalities of plant parents seem to mirror their plant children and vice versa – a plant otaku and his ground-defying airplants, an architect and his sublime flora sculptures.

When bringing more wild into our environment, should we consider our personalities against the plant’s to better coexist? Don’t be afraid to go a little potty.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this episode crane operator Nick, is called out to a very unusual job removing two old portable cabins from a recycling yard and replacing with new ones. But with each cabin weighing at least four tonnes and overhead electrical cables to negotiate this is a highly hazardous job. Seasoned recovery op Jim’s must rescue an abandoned Toyota from a live lane on the M1. Meanwhile rescue driver Jon must tow a 44-ton bus the wrong way down a dual carriageway….

programme.desc: In the middle of the Allgäu at the foot of the Alps, a holiday park of superlatives is being built on a gigantic area of 184 hectares! The construction of the new holiday park will cost a total of 350 million euros. Around 5000 guests are to spend their holidays in 1000 holiday homes. But it is still a long way to the opening: it is the largest building site southern Germany has ever seen. On this area, which is as big as 258 football fields, about one million holiday guests per year are expected soon. Around 1100 men are working at full capacity to ensure that everything is ready in time for the park's opening. 1000 holiday homes must be ready and habitable by then. A spa, an adventure pool, indoor playgrounds and 6 restaurants are also planned. The workers are under enormous time pressure. Will the mega holiday park be ready in time before the first guests arrive.

偵探艾迪森 -起霧之謎
programme.desc: Addison and Alex are filming a class-project documentary about a “typical day in Ayrton Park” – but things quickly become anything but typical when a mysterious fog envelops the entire downtown area.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -雙重謎團
programme.desc: Addison is faced with a double challenge: figuring out who is behind a series of very strange thefts in Ayrton Park, and then when she does discover that the perpetrator is her own mother, getting to the bottom of why her mom seems to have gone over to the “dark side”.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -寶特瓶
programme.desc: Watch Hepi and Briko transform plastic bottles into something out of this world. Literally.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -牙刷
programme.desc: Be prepared to be ''brushed'' off your feet with this entertaining episode.

programme.title: 優可 -維克去度假
programme.desc: Vik and his parents visit the most technologically-advanced city in the world. Amazed by the playgrounds in the city's high-tech park, he noticed that the city kids spend all their time staring at screens.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -雙贏局面
programme.desc: Hill Town's windmill has come to a halt, stopping the production of work juice. Riwahl is already on-site helping to get it up and running, but Sprinter also has an idea that may help. Will they get the mill running again.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -臭臭的老一
programme.desc: Duo and Trio move in with Sprinter because Solo's stopped showering and started to smell. To get out of that jam, Sprinter and Leo must figure out how they're going to get Solo showering again.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -潮汐
programme.desc: Lost at sea, Kit and Mr. Battery try to get the compass from the shipwreck, guarded by two surly captains.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -潛水艇
programme.desc: Kit and Mr. Battery dive into the deep ocean to retrieve Mr. Battery's lost camera.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -中世紀的衛生習慣
programme.desc: Howler isn't exactly a paragon of cleanliness! But seeing as he's got a soft spot for Dove, he needs to step up the hygiene if he wants to win her heart! So he introduces us to various medieval hygiene techniques.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -大溪地之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo have a presentation to prepare for school, and they are scratching their heads to find the most original way to do this. Our friends travel to Tahiti, where they meet with Amana and learn more about telling a story through dance.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -日本之旅, 第二部
programme.desc: Our heroes prepare for a sleepover in the HQ, but it seems impossible to divide the space, so they each have a separate bedroom. Alim knows of places where people feel more comfortable sleeping together in the same room. Everyone is soon in Japan for a new adventure.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -馬利之旅
programme.desc: Milo is trying to learn his poem but is having a hard time remembering the words. Alim thinks it is easier to learn something while listening to music! Zoe and Milo do not seem convinced, and Alim decides that only a short break to Mali could change this.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -加納利群島之旅
programme.desc: Is it possible to communicate over a distance with neither telephone nor internet access? A little trip to the Canary Islands could answer the question. With the help of their penfriend Kiko, our friends will learn to use the landscape to communicate with others.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -平等之牆
programme.desc: Aminata suggests to the kids to paint the old wall of the basketball court, but everyone wants to paint it their own way. Ending up alone, Mily wonders how she could make everyone agree with each other, despite all their differences in terms of style and taste.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -團結就是力量
programme.desc: Mily, along with her dog Pop, is really excited because they're joining an orienteering race! But things get complicated quickly when everybody does whatever they please. The group will realize that collaboration is the key to success.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -旋轉輪
programme.desc: Boom has created a lucky spinning wheel for Bhilkans to win prizes. Sprinter and Leo are skeptical about it. They figure out that the wheel is a super magnet attracting meteors towards Hilltown. How can Sprinter stop this disaster.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -分裂的畢爾卡
programme.desc: On Earth, you put up a flag to mark a particular spot. Therefore, Sprinter hoists a Bhilka flag at the town hall. But DiktaThor starts to put up his flags all over. Leo has a brilliant idea that helps Sprinter solve the problem with the town divided in two.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -寫程式和編碼
programme.desc: How did people compute before the invention of computers? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of computing. Have hands-on fun by making your own abacus, and get to know Ada Lovelace, the first computer programmer before the invention of computers.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -瘋狂的催化劑
programme.desc: What is a catalyst? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of chemical engineering. Have hands-on fun by producing your own cheese, and get to know Ryong Ryoo, who discovered a rock trapping water inside it can serve as catalyst in petrochemicals.

programme.title: 44隻貓第一季 -叢林裡的貓
programme.desc: A monster has been spotted at the botanical garden, and the Buffycats want to solve the mystery! There they meet the wild cat Jungle and Tata, a parrot! Our furry fellows have to protect their new friends from the dangers of the city.

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -愛波的骨頭
programme.desc: Ebb gets a new bone to chew while Flo and Ma go to buy spring bulbs. Ebb and Bird follow but miss them at the shop. Back home Ebb's bone is missing. Oh No! Ebb finds it ‘growing' in a plant pot. Flo had ‘planted' it (like her spring bulbs) for Ebb.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -過去現身
programme.desc: The team tries to decipher their first clue in the detention room when they are interrupted by a local historian - Miss Dumont. Principal Lounsberry assigns our heroes to perform in historical reenactment under the watchful eye of Miss Dumont.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -蘿絲與龍王
programme.desc: Rose is excited for Dragon Taming Class, where they meet Low Ong, the dragon king. However, Vicky and the evil Pied Piper turn Low Ong against the school. Rose and the others must break the spell in time to save the school.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -維京人
programme.desc: Like Raven and Little Lewis, the famous giants of the northern mists, the Vikings, are master looters and navigators. Besides being bloody warriors and shrewd negotiators, the Vikings are also great explorers, out to discover the world.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -領主與農民
programme.desc: Our humble peasant friend Howler can't wait for his next batch of pretzels! However, in the Middle Ages, the feudal system is ruthless, the lord always helping himself to a share of the peasant's yield. And, quite often, all that's left is a few meager crumbs.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -1859年風情派對
programme.desc: When the team's high-tech dance party is threatened by a power outage, they're frustrated and fly off to find a place where things are still normal. Mistakenly, they end up at a historic village, where they live like it's 150 years ago.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -辯論大賽
programme.desc: As far back as Ancient Greece, citizens met to debate the problems of the city. But if you were going to speak on the hill of the Pnyx, you'd better have known how to speak! For Howler, who mumbles and becomes confused, it's not easy to convince the crowd..

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -一探諾克文化
programme.desc: Famous artists known for their terracotta statuettes, the Noks were also excellent blacksmiths and incredible potters. And thanks to Howler's love of good food, they turned out to be honey experts and designers of innovative beehives..

programme.title: 動物大使館 -拉法的一天
programme.desc: Meet the Loro Parque Foundation Scientific Director - Rafa, also known as the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque'. He wears the badge with pride and every day he surrounds himself with all things ornithological - from parrots and puffins to penguins.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -紐西蘭
programme.desc: Explored Auckland's War Memorial Museum, Waitomo's glowworms, Queenstown's skyline gondola, 415-ft bungy jump at Kawaru Bridge, and a thrilling shotover jet ride-unforgettable week in New Zealand.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -茂宜島
programme.desc: Explored Maui, Hawaii: Scuba lessons with turtles, Piiholo Ranch's longest zip line, Haiku rainforest hike, and capped the day with Ululani's Shave Ice. Final day included standup paddle boarding and surfing lessons. Adventure-packed week in paradise.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -潮汐

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -牙刷
programme.desc: Be prepared to be ''brushed'' off your feet with this entertaining episode.

programme.desc: When Addison and Alex taste the new pizza that Mr. DiGiovanni has created especially for Tess's birthday, they find out it doesn't taste good at all and so they set out to investigate what the problem is. Has Mr. DiGiovanni lost his sense of taste.

programme.desc: There is a new ranger in the park. Mai, Oto, and Vik return from their holidays and realize Ranger Loops is nowhere to be found. Desperate to have their friend back, the kids are trying to find a way to bring Ranger Loops back.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -鑽油平台
programme.desc: A visit to an oil platform leads to an accident that Kit and Mr. Battery must set right.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -海嘯
programme.desc: Kit and Mr. Battery fight the albatross for the stolen safety buoys.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -神話與傳說
programme.desc: After taking care of his daily chores, Howler ‘gets away from it all' by daydreaming about wonderful encounters! In the process, he takes us through various contemporary beliefs, myths and legends, powered by his very rich imagination.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -泰國之旅

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -伊朗之旅

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -午夜的12聲鐘響
programme.desc: It's the New Year celebration, and everybody brings a traditional dish. On this occasion, Mily learns that Kun, Hamid and several of her friends celebrate the New Year at a different time.

programme.title: 44隻貓第一季 -警察貓出動

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -預備起
programme.desc: Joe and Uncle Jack help Flo repaint her dinghy as Morris shows off. There's a race to Granny's between Flo and Joe's dinghies. Joe's boat is ahead when Morris falls overboard. He is rescued. Flo's dinghy wins the race. For once Ebb has outshone Morris.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -舊道路

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -食物
programme.desc: Unlike life in our modern society, in the Middle Ages, people don't eat their fill every day. We follow our foodie Howler as he scavenges around for anything that takes his fancy, overstepping his mark as a mere peasant.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -奇怪的審判
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, animals are considered responsible for their actions and must answer to their crimes in a court of law! A crazy trial takes place, with Howler as the animals' attorney and Roach as the judge and persecutor.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇探險隊的果汁之旅
programme.desc: When the team wants a new water slide for the clubhouse beach, they decide to fund it by selling Anabella's delicious lemonade. But the slide costs a lot, and they want it fast! So how can they sell as much lemonade as possible? They split into two teams.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -法敕警察

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -波科諾
programme.desc: Pocono Mountains adventure: Zipped through Camelback Mountain, segway hike, tested wilderness survival skills, and tried wakeboarding at Lake Harmony. Packed week in the scenic outdoors.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -鑽油平台
programme.desc: A visit to an oil platform leads to an accident that Kit and Mr. Battery must set right.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -海嘯

programme.title: 地球小尖兵 -海中的植物

programme.title: 打造貓樂園 -貓床

programme.desc: After courageously jumping into the Point of No Return, the team negotiate whirlpools and hurl themselves over vertical cliffs into deep pools far below. Finally they reach the river's end – victorious and beaming with joy, they make their way back to the Zebrabus.

programme.desc: The youngsters set off through difficult terrain before taking on fearsome rapids. Their journey takes them through a plant kingdom filled with thousands of unique plants and animals, including an unusual sea bird that cannot fly. Can you guess what animal it might be.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -考驗
programme.desc: To find a piece of the mysterious Ephemychron, the Nektons have to fight off whirlpools, zero visibility, and giant, robotic jellyfish.

programme.sub-title: 第三十集：有情人終成眷屬?
programme.desc: 半年後，匯商銀行、壹休好吃聯手和蘭溪古鎮達成了合作，致力於推動當地的傳統美食。200天紀念日，唐漾送給蔣時延薑餅味的香水，而蔣時延則送唐漾一對精緻的碗，兌現兩人當年許下的誓言.

programme.title: 行政長官表揚榜 2025
programme.desc: 「行政長官表揚榜」獎勵計劃旨在公開表揚優秀而且具示範作用的公務員團隊或人員，激勵公務員不斷求進，透過廣泛宣傳讓公眾更清楚認識政府的工作及公務員團隊優秀的面貌。. 新一輪「行政長官表揚榜」獎勵計劃的得獎隊伍為「2025年3月前赴緬甸地震災區救援的特區救援隊」（特區救援隊）及「啟德體育園開幕跨部門籌備專組」（啟德體育園開幕籌備專組）.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 無極飛行
programme.sub-title: 無極飛行第四集：墨西哥 - 森林播種機
programme.desc: 墨西哥農民習慣焚燒田地，為下一季耕種作準備。火勢往往會升級，波及山上的樹林。 在恰帕斯州，每年就有二到三萬公頃的自然地帶被燒毀。 面對這個悲劇，被暱稱為「爺爺機長」的, José Camacho有個想法：利用他的小型飛機在被燒燬的土地上重新造林，加快大自然的修復過程…… 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2023年10月16日 星期一晚上10時30分 In Mexico there is an ancestral and devastating pastoral tradition… the burn. The peasants set fire to their fields to clean them in order to sow the next crops, often these fires escalate and spread to the wooded hills. Between 20 to 30,000 hectares of natural areas go up in smoke every year in Chiapas! Faced with this tragedy, José Camacho affectionately nicknamed El capitán, had this simple idea: to use his small plane to reforest the devastated lands and accelerate the natural process of reforestation. . Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2023.10.16 MON 10:30pm.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第八十八集 - 「好媽媽 別咆哮」
programme.desc: BobieLand 第八十八集-「好媽媽別咆哮」. 編導:蔡少傑. 為求「由Okie Bobie 扮演子樂媽媽代替見家長」的計畫順利進行，各園長與小朋友從髮型、化妝及服裝對Okie . Bobie進行大改造，令Okie Bobie形神兼備似足子樂媽媽。. 【More More魔術see】. Magic Kevin 向大家講述了一個他與小朋友David的一次魔術表演，更教導小朋友一起變了一個關於Okie Bobie的魔術。. 【手作EASY JOB】. 圖媽媽與圖圖了解到大家的衝突源於溝通的面向不同，本星期的『手作EASY JOB』將由圖圖母子決定教大家製作一幅從不同角度觀看，會有不同效果的神奇畫作.

programme.title: 紅粉緋緋與彼得叻叻豬
programme.desc: (A) 緋緋試穿一雙神秘的鞋子，但當她穿上後，竟無法停止跳舞！. (B) 彼得有一首歌跟大家分享，但似乎沒有人有興趣，可能因為他用滑板車那個嘈吵的喇叭來演奏。. . 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2020年11月1日 星期日 上午9時30分 (網上重溫) 至 2021年10月31日 星期日. (A) Pinkalicious tries on a mysterious pair of shoes. But after she puts them on, she can't stop dancing!. (B) Peter has a new song to share with everyone. Only no one seems to be interested. Perhaps it's because his song uses his really loud scooter horn…. . Channel: RTHK 31 Time: (First Run) 2020.11.1 SUN 9:30am (On-line Catch-up) Till 2021.10.31 SUN.

programme.title: 我們的當打之年
programme.sub-title: 第二十五集：熊啟明幫谷嶠解決抄襲事件
programme.desc: 熊啟明來到白雪家樓下，陪著谷嶠一起等。袁歌不滿鄭宴熙不顧公司利益栽贓陷害谷嶠，讓鄭宴熙交接完工作後，自己提出離職。谷嶠終於在樓下等到白雪，白雪堅持自己沒有抄襲。谷嶠覺得可能是賈龍撒謊。同時，熊啟明暗示賈龍只要他不再維權，就給讓他擔任市場部經理.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
31看世界 - 無極飛行
programme.sub-title: 無極飛行第四集：墨西哥 - 森林播種機
programme.desc: 墨西哥農民習慣焚燒田地，為下一季耕種作準備。火勢往往會升級，波及山上的樹林。 在恰帕斯州，每年就有二到三萬公頃的自然地帶被燒毀。 面對這個悲劇，被暱稱為「爺爺機長」的, José Camacho有個想法：利用他的小型飛機在被燒燬的土地上重新造林，加快大自然的修復過程…… 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2023年10月16日 星期一晚上10時30分 In Mexico there is an ancestral and devastating pastoral tradition… the burn. The peasants set fire to their fields to clean them in order to sow the next crops, often these fires escalate and spread to the wooded hills. Between 20 to 30,000 hectares of natural areas go up in smoke every year in Chiapas! Faced with this tragedy, José Camacho affectionately nicknamed El capitán, had this simple idea: to use his small plane to reforest the devastated lands and accelerate the natural process of reforestation. . Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2023.10.16 MON 10:30pm.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
南來北往
programme.sub-title: 第二十五集：馬魁、汪新調查殘肢案
programme.desc: 馬魁、汪新暗中蹲守疑犯，終於在第三天夜裡，看著疑犯提著編織袋離開店鋪，二人跟踪疑犯來到一處破房子。汪新檢查了被扔的編織袋只有生活垃圾。汪新試圖從弟弟着手調查，結果發現，董家兄弟與一起殺人案有關。同時，一個撿破爛的老頭在垃圾堆裡翻出一條斷臂.

programme.title: 南來北往
programme.sub-title: 第二十六集：汪新幫忙馬燕擺攤
programme.desc: 馬燕告訴汪新自己從溫州進了一批釦子，先在街角擺攤，汪新上前幫忙賣力吆喝。馬燕領導來家裡探望請病假的馬燕，馬魁才得知馬燕瞞著跟單位請了病假。馬魁偷偷跟著馬燕出門，發現馬燕竟擺攤做生意，馬魁氣得直接上前掀翻了攤位.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第八十九集 - 「好媽媽 別咆哮」
programme.desc: BobieLand 第八十九集-「好媽媽別咆哮」. 編導:蔡少傑. Okie Bobie的外型經過大改造後，搖身一變成為Okie 媽咪。而園長澔天為保計畫萬無一失,找來Sarah姐姐扮演子樂老師，與Okie Bobie和子樂，進行一次見家長的模擬面試。真正的子樂媽媽卻在現場突然出現，今次又如何收科呢？. 【嘉賓來了】. 溝通和理解在親子關係中非常重要。. 本集邀請了「表達藝術治療師」Jessica 姐姐，教大家親子溝通的重要性，更和小朋友分享了一種新的語言和小遊戲，令溝通變得更加得心應手.

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 來見識世界上時而慵懶，時而節省體能，但永遠緩慢的動物BB。從本能地以每分鐘兩米的速度行動來節約能量的樹懶寶寶，到在母親背上搭順風車的天鵝寶寶，來與我們一起探索地球上十大行動最慢的動物寶寶吧.

programme.desc: 小特在屋外發現一隻毛毛蟲，決定收養牠。但迪迪、佩佩和德仔都不接受這個新朋友。接下來會怎樣.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 奧圖和兩隻海鸚正在享受寧靜，迪迪和佩佩卻突然加入嬉鬧。被吵煩的奧圖發明「靜音槍」，讓所有人靜下來.

programme.title: 時光正好
programme.desc: 中年女性許夢安從噩夢中驚醒，下屬小荷發來的方案又令她惱火。她只能親自上手修改。老公李臨貼心為她做着早餐，她卻意外發現李臨手機裏初戀女友梅一朵發來邀請他去北京聚會的郵件.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 照顧者們
programme.desc: 十一歲小學生吳懿晴Haley患有罕見病「石頭症」，一些重要關節被鎖緊，形成駝背問題，影響上身的活動能力。她不能自行如廁，需要24小時陪伴照顧。. 媽媽Yoki是主要照顧者，至今一直陪伴她對抗病情。而Haley要面對的，不單是肉體的缺陷，而是因缺陷帶來無限的限制⋯⋯. Haley好喜歡溜冰同踏單車，不過，「石頭症」的敵人，就是傷口。一旦患者跌倒，傷口可能不會自動復原，更會新增骨頭，有機會永久傷殘。. 「讓她嘗試，就有機會面對永久傷殘的風險，但面對有限的時間，是不是要盡量讓她嘗試，好好享受人生？」. Haley所患的病，粗略估計，每100萬人中只有一人，是「百萬」中無一。Yoki擔心Haley會變得越來越弱，決定放棄本來穩定的工作，多點陪伴Haley，珍惜仍然可以一家人到處走動的時光.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解3
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解3》邀請了漁護署淡水魚工作小組組長陳浩鵬，分享有關河蝦的知識。本集以典型米蝦、廣東米蝦和台灣沼蝦作例子，並首次利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索河蝦的外貌特徵、食性、生活習性.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: 「默書」一直是小學生的集體回憶，《小學教育課程指引》去年更新，建議學校減少默書篇幅、檢視測考。有小學本學年起取消中英文科默書，校方指該校原要求各級每學年中英默書達32次，但發現即使學生默書高分，寫作或考試時仍「執筆忘字」，校方希望釋放空間讓學生看課外書，亦有助識字，會透過遊戲學習、AI 教學、鼓勵閱讀等方式促進學生認字識字。 一場「不默書」革命，老師如何看到學生的改變？對於一向著緊學生學業的香港家長而言，他們如何接受「不默書」？在AI、智能電話、語音輸入盛行的年代，會否擔心學生日後會「執筆忘字」.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解3
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解3》邀請了漁護署淡水魚工作小組組長陳浩鵬，分享有關河蝦的知識。本集以典型米蝦、廣東米蝦和台灣沼蝦作例子，並首次利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索河蝦的外貌特徵、食性、生活習性.

programme.title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團
programme.sub-title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團 - 北京及山東
programme.desc: 由外交部駐港公署、教育局，與明天更好基金聯合主辦「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽」已於五月份圓滿舉行。比賽過後，一眾優勝學生獲香港賽馬會特別贊助，參加內地參訪團，用腳步丈量神州大地的壯麗山河，用心來感受國家現代化建設的偉大成就，增加對國家的歸屬感和國民身份認同。. 參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的學生分別不同的中學。參訪團分別到訪北京、曲阜，泰安，潍坊，威海以及青島等地，亦會參觀景點，如故宫博物院、釣魚台、中國甲午戰爭博物館、總體國家安全觀主题展館等，更有機會旁聽外交部例行記者會並與青年外交官座談。. 節目會紀錄學生參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的全部過程，總結行程的所思所感，以體驗的形式學習、了解國情，以帶出學生將課本知識與考察內容有效地結合，對國家在科技、文化、經濟發展有更深一層認識.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第十九集：張克寒真實身份被確認
programme.desc: 在鐘城鐵馬山上，張克寒被村民小管碰到，小管立即去報案。秦川帶人去現場，卻讓張克寒再次逃脫，但在他的遺留物品中檢測到了他的DNA生物資訊。隨後，張克寒回到昀城被一男子舉報，警方終得知他的真實身份和姓名。警方來到張克寒家採血，張克寒聽聞後又連夜逃跑了.
